rows.label: AUV hydrostatic pressure
rows.envelope: <=51 bar abs covers up to roughly 500 m before deeper-hull concept review.
rows.interpretation: 31 bar absolute pressure implied at rated depth.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm hull material, safety factor, penetrators, seals, buckling margin and test pressure.

rows.label: AUV endurance minutes
rows.envelope: Arithmetic only; mission endurance needs hotel load, propulsion and reserve energy proof.
rows.interpretation: 480 minutes mission endurance before energy-budget proof.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm speed profile, payload load, reserve margin, battery derating and recovery scenario.
